newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares still buoyant, below record.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares still buoyant, below record.

text.p: Latvian shares continued in buoyant trade on Friday with market turnover only slightly lower than yesterday's all-time high of 575,797 lats.
Total turnover came to 463,262 lats and market leader Unibanka traded 287,806 lats but was stable at 3.22 lats.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain maker gained to 1.88 from 1.64 lats as it traded 39,425 lats of stock.
The other two official list shares saw a healthy rise in prices. Staburadze confectionery closed at 3.16 lats against 2.75 lats and Riga Transport Fleet jumped to 1.20 from 1.05 lats.
They had volume of 35,534 lats and 5,346 lats respectively.
Elsewhere on the secondary list, several other stocks were well traded.
Jekabpils Sugar gained six santimes to 48 santimes and turned over 19,485 lats while the Riga Yeast factory turned over 17,325 lats and climbed 15 santimes to 3.15 lats.
Lode Brick factory was also busy on trade of 16,774 and it rose to 1.56 lats from 1.36 lats.
